title: Ultimate Custom Run
description:
Customize your Slay the Spire 2 custom runs with adjustable modifiers, new starting options and a cleaner selection menu.

[h2]A cleaner Custom Run menu[/h2]
[list]
[*]Modifiers are organized into collapsible groups.
[*]Mutually exclusive choices are linked visually.
[*]Specialized, All Star and Friendship have their variants grouped under one checkbox.
[/list]

[h2]Save modifier presets[/h2]
Save your current modifier selection and slider values as a named loadout, then restore it from the dropdown beside the modifier list. Presets are stored locally on your computer. Saving another loadout with the same name replaces the existing one.

[h2]Adjustable modifier values[/h2]
Use the game's native sliders to choose how strong each modifier should be.
[list]
[*][b]Specialized, All Star and Friendship:[/b] 1-10 cards or copies, step 1.
[*][b]Draft:[/b] 5-20 cards, step 5.
[*][b]Sealed Deck:[/b] Two sliders: cards to choose (5 up to pool size minus 5) and pool size (10-60). Both use step 5 and default to 10 cards from 30 offers. Reducing the pool clamps the first slider. Both values are saved with runs and presets, and synchronized from the co-op host. Extra Card Choice / Card Swarm does not enlarge the configured pool.
[*][b]Insanity:[/b] 5-60 cards, step 5.
[*][b]Hoarder:[/b] 1-5 additional copies, step 1. The original card is not included in this number.
[*][b]Double Trouble:[/b] 2-3 different bosses per act, step 1, default 2, with normal rewards from each. A10 does not add an extra boss.
[*][b]Campfires between bosses:[/b] Optional Double Trouble submodifier, shown only while its parent is active. Adds a normal Rest Site between each pair of bosses; off by default. Saved with runs and presets, synchronized from the co-op host.
[*][b]Midas:[/b] 150-300% of normal gold rewards, step 5%. For example, 200% means twice the normal gold.
[/list]
Normal, Draft and Pick Any variants share the same value within their modifier family. Values are saved with the run and synchronized from the co-op host.

[h2]Custom Run parameters[/h2]
Set floors per act (vanilla or 8-30), base hand size (vanilla or 0-15), base energy (vanilla or 0-10), and enemy HP, enemy damage, and player HP multipliers (25-500%, step 25%). Values are saved with runs and presets, and synchronized from the co-op host.

[h2]Choose individual Ascension effects[/h2]
The Ascension group contains all ten effects as separate negative modifiers, with red names to make their penalties clear. Enable Double Boss to fight two bosses at the end of Act 3 without the other Ascension penalties, or combine only the effects you want.

Enabling any Ascension modifier sets the run's Ascension level to 0. Changing the Ascension level disables all individual Ascension modifiers while keeping your other modifiers selected. These options are saved with the run and synchronized from the co-op host.

[h2]More ways to start and play[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Super Draft:[/b] Add card rewards to your starting deck until you pass. Each pick risks a Curse: 0.5%, doubling each offer. At 128%, gain one guaranteed Curse plus a 28% chance of another. Passing adds no Curse; each player drafts independently.
[*][b]Must Have (negative):[/b] Take a card from every card reward before leaving. Rerolls remain available; non-card rewards remain optional. Passing during Super Draft is allowed.
[*][b]Neow!!:[/b] Restores the usual starter relic choice after the other starting effects.
[*][b]Specialized - Draft:[/b] Choose a card from a Card Reward, then add the selected number of copies.
[*][b]Specialized - Pick Any:[/b] Choose any eligible card from your character's pool, then add the selected number of copies.
[*][b]All Star - Draft:[/b] Start with Colorless card rewards instead of random Colorless cards.
[*][b]Friendship:[/b] Start with copies of a random Co-Op card. The Draft variant lets you choose Co-Op card rewards. Available in co-op only.
[*][b]Colorless Cards:[/b] Colorless cards can appear in card rewards.
[*][b]Rich Loot:[/b] Treasure chests contain 1 extra relic to choose from.
[*][b]Card Swarm:[/b] Card rewards contain 1 extra card.
[/list]

[h2]How to use[/h2]
[olist]
[*]Enable Ultimate Custom Run in Settings > Mod Settings.
[*]Start a Custom Run, select your modifiers and adjust their values.
[*]Resolve your selected starting effects at Neow.
[/olist]

[h2]Compatibility[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]No BaseLib dependency.[/b]
[*][b]Co-op:[/b] Every player needs the mod. Only the host can change the sliders.
[*][b]Daily Challenges:[/b] Custom-only modifiers stay out of the Daily pool. Vanilla Daily values are preserved.
[*]Hoarder still prevents Merchant card removal. Midas still prevents Smithing at Rest Sites.
[*]Built against Slay the Spire 2 v0.111.0. Pre-release build.
[/list]

[h2]Report bugs & contribute[/h2]
Found a bug or have an idea for the mod? [url=https://github.com/vertopolkaLF/ultimate-custom-run/issues/new/choose]Report a bug or suggest a feature[/url].

Want to help improve Ultimate Custom Run? [url=https://github.com/vertopolkaLF/ultimate-custom-run]Visit the GitHub repository[/url] for source code, build instructions and contribution guidelines. Gameplay testing, documentation improvements and pull requests are welcome.
changeNote: Added named modifier presets. Save the selected modifiers and slider values, then restore them from the Custom Run dropdown. Updated the Workshop description and screenshot gallery.
